segments.title: Make Siri forget your chats
segments.say: Siri remembers you, part three: here's how to make it forget your chats.

segments.title: Your Siri chats are saved
segments.say: The new Siri app saves your conversations, and they sync to your other Apple devices.

segments.title: Auto-delete in 3 taps
segments.say: To auto-delete them, open Settings, tap Siri, then Keep Conversations.

segments.title: Pick 30 days or 1 year
segments.say: Pick thirty days or one year. Older chats are deleted for good.

segments.title: Delete one chat now
segments.say: To delete just one, swipe left on it in the Siri app and tap delete.
